name: std::hash<std::variant>
intro:
The template specialization of std::hash for the std::variant template allows users to obtain hashes of variant objects.

The specialization std::hash<std::variant<Types...>> is enabled (see std::hash) if every specialization in std::hash<std::remove_const_t<Types>>... is enabled, and is disabled otherwise.

The member functions of this specialization are not guaranteed to be noexcept.

sections.title: Template parameters
sections.text:
Types

 -

 the types of the alternatives supported by the variant object

sections.title: Notes
sections.text: Unlike std::hash<std::optional>, hash of a variant does not typically equal the hash of the contained value; this makes it possible to distinguish std::variant<int, int> holding the same value as different alternatives.

summary: The template specialization of std::hash for the std::variant template allows users to obtain hashes of variant objects.
